title: Certified lower bounds for λ1·Area on cells of pentagon shape space by piecewise-affine transplantation, and an explicit ball of strict minimality of the regular pentagon
description:
Computer-assisted proof candidate (for the stated cells and the stated ball), not peer reviewed. This is not a proof of the Pólya–Szegő conjecture for pentagons.

Version 1.1 adds local_theorem/: a computer-assisted proof candidate that the regular pentagon is the strict minimiser of F in the explicit ball |z − c|₂ < 52429/2²⁰ of the fixed-first-edge shape chart, with a certificate checked in exact rational arithmetic, independent of the PAQC certificates; both levels of its certificate were recomputed by a second-party AI reviewer with separately written programs (not peer review). The new local theorem makes no claim outside that ball. Version 1.0 (1 November 2026) remains available unchanged. A preprint by H. Wang (arXiv:2611.22305, 17 November 2026) claims a proof of the Pólya–Szegő inequality for all simple polygons with at most n ≥ 5 sides; it has not been peer reviewed, and neither version of this repository depends on it.

Version 1.0 content:

A method (PAQC) that certifies F(P) = λ1(P)·|P| > F(regular pentagon) simultaneously for every pentagon P in a six-dimensional box of shape space, using only the first Dirichlet eigenvalues of the 64 corner pentagons and exact matrix inequalities from a piecewise-affine transplantation; six certificates for five boxes, evaluated in ball arithmetic; a partial independent second-party replay; a short paper; and an estimate of the cost of covering a whole region. AI assistance is disclosed in README.md. Licences: text and data CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
